row.notes: Sets stream position, wraps the buffer at +0x98/+0xa0 in a memory reader, reads a u64 nanosecond timestamp (split into sec and nsec at outFrame+0) and then 20 packed 0x1e-byte car records into 0xc0-byte slots. Each record is unpacked: smallest-three 10-bit quaternion (/511 - 1, sqrt for missing component) to +0x80..+0x8c, position vec to +0x90, signed 10-bit speed to +0x1c and scaled (/0.001/3600) to +0x40, s8/127 to +0x20, two u8/255 to +0x24/+0x28, flag bit to +0x30, valid=1 at +0xcc. Returns 1 if all 20 records read; outNextPos = read offset + stream +0xb0 + 600. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): agree.
